note: `room` and `no_wrap_hit` place compact subsets of Conf_n in NoHit for large p, and `Bound.volume` with `extendsBound` gives a uniform bound on values only; the derivative bound on Delta_l of the lattice moment and the convergence of the interpolants to the derivatives of f_{p,v} are not stated.

snippet.text: theorem room {K : Set (Points n)} (H : IsCompact K) : ∀ᶠ p : ℕ in atTop, K ⊆ Inside S p n := by

proof_context.conclusion: `room` puts a compact set inside `Inside S p n` for all large p.

snippet.text: theorem no_wrap_hit {p : ℕ} {x} (h : x ∈ Inside S p n) : x ∈ NoHit S p n ↔ x ∈ conf n := by

proof_context.conclusion: `no_wrap_hit` identifies `NoHit S p n` with `conf n` at points inside the period box.

volume (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token) (K : Set (Points n)) (hp : IsCompact K) (hx : K ⊆ conf n) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ g.late (fun N p => ∀ b, tag (C.S.a N) b ∈ K → ‖lifted C N p v b‖ ≤ D)

proof_context.conclusion: `Bound.volume` gives, for compact K inside `conf n`, a constant D such that the lattice values `lifted C N p v b` are bounded by D for tagged points in K, late in (N, p).

snippet.text:
private lemma extendsBound (H : Bound C f) {n : ℕ} {P} (Hp : f.Meshes C P) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token) {x}
    (hx : x ∈ generic n) : ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ‖(P (f.per i)).read x v‖ ≤ D := by
  obtain ⟨K,hk,hI,hU⟩ := exists_compact_subset (genericOpen n) hx
  obtain ⟨R,hR,H⟩ := H.volume n v K hk (Subset.trans hU (generic_conf _))
  refine ⟨R,?_⟩
  unfold Order.late at H
  have ht := (chosen (S := C.S) x).comp f.mesh.cofinal
  filter_upwards [H, f.per.cofinal.eventually (room C.S hk)] with i hi hr
  let p := f.per i
  have he : x ∈ Cyclic C.S p n := (no_wrap_tie C.S (hr (interior_subset hI))).2 hx
  have hh := f.evaluated C Hp p n v x he (fun i => address (C.S.a (f.mesh i)) x) ht
  refine le_of_tendsto hh.norm ?_
  filter_upwards [hi,ht.eventually (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hI)] with j h hk
  exact h _ hk

proof_context.conclusion: At a generic point, the limit values `(P (f.per i)).read x v` are bounded by D eventually in i, using `room`, `no_wrap_tie` and `Order.evaluated`.
